published_prior_art.cite: VanDerVaart1998Asymptotic supplies generic LAN, but not this hidden-treatment posterior-contrast local experiment.
Kaji2021WeakIdentification is generic weak-identification theory; ZwiernikSmith2012TreeCumulants studies binary latent-tree geometry, not this exact causal score incompatibility witness.
EvansHansenStark2005Minimax establishes Bayes-minimax duality and bounded-location results, but not the proposed connected-interval problem on the nuisance-indexed posterior-contrast surface.

SchaferStark2009Optimal gives Monte-Carlo approximation over finite prior support; SchlemperMoreira2026ConfidenceSets gives inversion algorithms for weak-IV tests, neither gives the claimed two-sided CAD/CDF certificate for this continuum decision problem.
EvansHansenStark2005Minimax supplies relevant minimax confidence-set theory but not this profile-hull optimality characterization.
EvansHansenStark2005Minimax already proves the bounded-normal truncated-Pratt optimum; novelty is limited to the legal hidden-treatment embedding and profile comparison.
No checked source provides the exact support and phase diagram for this specified curved posterior-contrast fiber.

soundness_flags.label: def:legal-fiber / lem:legal-projection
soundness_flags.one_line: The fiber quantifies a candidate law R but every incorporated assumption is written under the fixed R_0, so “R satisfies ass:*” does not state candidate-R restrictions and cannot support the claimed exact legal projection.

soundness_flags.label: def:cad-certificate / thm:certified-computation
soundness_flags.one_line: L_M and U_M are only named as quantities assembled from enclosures: no finite primal/dual optimization, action discretization, support parametrization, or formula defines either sequence, so their monotonicity and finite stopping claim has no determinate mathematical object.

source_verification_receipts.version: 2003 technical-report preprint corroborating the cited 2005 Bernoulli article; journal table of contents confirms the 2005 publication
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For a bounded normal mean with alpha<1/2 and tau<=2 z_(1-alpha), the truncated Pratt procedure attains minimax expected Lebesgue measure; it is not minimax when tau exceeds that threshold.
The paper approximates minimax expected-size procedures using a finite-support prior polytope, optimization, and Monte Carlo; its numerical confidence level and minimaxity are approximate.

The paper studies causal effects with an unobserved treatment and proxies, gives nonparametric identification of several causal effects, and develops semiparametric efficient estimation with a semiparametric EM approach.
The manuscript develops exact or approximation-based inversion methods for weak-IV confidence sets, including polynomial/root-finding methods and approximations with diminishing coverage error.
Kaji gives a general formulation of weak identification through weakly regular parameters and underlying regular parameters; it does not provide the proposal’s finite proxy-fiber witness.
The paper parametrizes binary latent tree models and studies their identifiability and singular geometry.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corresponding to Electronic Journal of Statistics 5, 2011
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work characterizes binary-tree latent-model geometry through polynomial equations together with positivity-induced inequalities.
Consistency, conditional exchangeability, and positivity are standard causal-identification assumptions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rewrite every member condition in def:legal-fiber with the bound candidate law R, then prove the displayed semialgebraic projection from those candidate-law restrictions rather than from fixed-baseline assumptions.

Replace the prose-only CAD certificate with explicit finite primal and dual programs at level M, including observation/action grids, finite support variables, tail bounds, and formal formulas for L_M and U_M.

Add a sampled-data confidence procedure with an explicit LAN-risk transfer or clearly retitle the contribution as a local Gaussian benchmark, so the causal applied consumer does not overstate deployability.

recommended_next_step: Revise the legal-fiber quantification and make the certificate sequences explicit; retain the field-level curved-fiber benchmark if those repairs succeed.
